# FinCalc

> FinCalc is a free collection of 60 online financial calculators covering personal finance, investing, loans, retirement, and business finance, plus 64 in-depth guides on the reasoning behind the math. All calculators run entirely in the browser — no signup, no data stored server-side.

## Calculators — Personal Finance (33)

- [401(k) Calculator](https://finclac.com/401k): Estimate how your 401(k) balance grows to retirement, including employer match, salary growth, and IRS contribution limits
- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://finclac.com/autoloan): Calculate your car payment including down payment, trade-in value, and sales tax
- [50/30/20 Budget Calculator](https://finclac.com/budget): Compare your actual spending against the 50/30/20 budget rule and see exactly where you're over or under, category by category
- [Credit Card Payoff Calculator](https://finclac.com/ccpayoff): See how long it really takes to pay off a credit card on minimum payments vs a fixed payment, and how much interest each approach costs
- [Debt Payoff Planner](https://finclac.com/debt): Calculate how long it takes to pay off all your debts and compare snowball vs avalanche payoff strategies
- [Debt Snowball vs Avalanche](https://finclac.com/debtcomp): Compare debt snowball vs avalanche payoff strategies side by side and see which saves more interest
- [Debt-to-Income Ratio Calculator](https://finclac.com/dti): Calculate your debt-to-income ratio (front-end and back-end DTI) and see how it compares to what lenders typically look for
- [Emergency Fund Calculator](https://finclac.com/emergencyfund): Calculate how much you need in your emergency fund based on your actual monthly expenses
- [FIRE Calculator](https://finclac.com/fire): Calculate your years to financial independence and FI number, and compare Lean, Fat, Coast, and Barista FIRE
- [Health Insurance Cost Calculator](https://finclac.com/healthinsurance): Compare two health insurance plans by estimating your true total annual cost, including premiums, deductibles, coinsurance, and out-of-pocket maximums
- [Financial Health Score](https://finclac.com/healthscore): Get a 0-100 financial health score based on your savings rate, debt-to-income ratio, and emergency fund coverage
- [How Much HELOC Can You Get?](https://finclac.com/heloc): Estimate your HELOC credit limit, interest-only draw period payments, and full repayment costs based on your home value and mortgage balance
- [Inflation Calculator](https://finclac.com/inflation): Calculate how inflation erodes purchasing power over time — see what an amount then is worth now, or will be worth in the future
- [Life Insurance Needs Calculator](https://finclac.com/lifeinsurance): Calculate how much life insurance coverage you need based on income replacement, debts, mortgage, and future expenses
- [Loan / EMI Calculator](https://finclac.com/loan): Calculate your loan EMI instantly with a full amortization schedule showing principal vs interest
- [Loan Comparison Calculator](https://finclac.com/loancomp): Compare up to 3 loan offers side by side on EMI, total interest, fees, and total cost to find the cheapest one
- [Loan Eligibility Calculator](https://finclac.com/loaneligibility): Find out how much loan you may qualify for based on your income, existing debts, interest rate, and tenure, using the same DTI method lenders use
- [Millionaire Calculator](https://finclac.com/millionaire): Find out exactly what age you'll become a millionaire based on your savings, monthly contributions, and investment return
- [Mortgage Comparison Calculator](https://finclac.com/mortcomp): Compare multiple mortgage offers side by side, including 15-year vs 30-year terms and different rates
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://finclac.com/mortgage): Calculate your monthly mortgage payment, total interest, and full amortization schedule, including PMI
- [Net Worth Calculator](https://finclac.com/networth): Calculate your total net worth from assets and liabilities, see your liquid vs
- [Loan Prepayment Calculator](https://finclac.com/prepay): See exactly how much time and interest you save by prepaying your loan with extra monthly payments or a lump sum
- [Provident Fund Calculator](https://finclac.com/provident): Calculate your provident fund maturity value, interest earned, and year-by-year balance growth with step-up contributions
- [Refinance Break-Even Calculator](https://finclac.com/refinance): See how many months it takes to recoup refinancing closing costs through lower payments, and whether refinancing actually saves you money
- [Rental Yield Calculator](https://finclac.com/rental): Calculate gross and net rental yield for any property investment, with a full expense breakdown
- [Rental Property Calculator](https://finclac.com/rentalprop): Analyze a rental property's cap rate, cash-on-cash return, and NOI before you buy
- [Rent vs Buy Calculator](https://finclac.com/rentvsbuy): Compare your projected net worth renting vs buying a home, including opportunity cost, appreciation, and the exact breakeven year
- [Retirement Calculator](https://finclac.com/retirement): Calculate exactly how much you need to retire using the 25x rule and 4% safe withdrawal rate
- [Salary Calculator](https://finclac.com/salary): Convert your pay between hourly, daily, monthly, and yearly salary instantly
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://finclac.com/savings): Calculate compound interest growth on your savings with regular monthly contributions and APY comparison
- [Savings Goal Calculator](https://finclac.com/savingsgoal): Calculate exactly how much to save each month to reach any financial goal by your target date
- [Social Security Benefit Estimator](https://finclac.com/socialsecurity): See how claiming Social Security early or delaying to 70 changes your monthly benefit, based on your estimated benefit at full retirement age
- [US Federal Income Tax Estimator](https://finclac.com/tax): Estimate your US federal income tax with both marginal and effective tax rates

## Calculators — Investing & Valuation (15)

- [Asset Allocation Calculator](https://finclac.com/allocation): Find your ideal stocks, bonds, cash, gold, and crypto allocation based on age and risk tolerance
- [CAGR Calculator](https://finclac.com/cagr): Free CAGR calculator shows you how to calculate compound annual growth rate step by step, with Rule of 72 doubling time and historical benchmark comparisons
- [Dollar Cost Averaging (DCA) Calculator](https://finclac.com/dca): Calculate shares bought, average cost per share, and ending value from regular investing vs a lump sum
- [DCF Valuation Calculator](https://finclac.com/dcf): Calculate a stock's intrinsic value using discounted cash flow analysis
- [Dividend Growth Calculator](https://finclac.com/divgrowth): Project your future dividend income and yield on cost, and compare dividend growth rates across stocks
- [Dividend Reinvestment (DRIP)](https://finclac.com/drip): See how dividend reinvestment grows your portfolio over decades
- [ETF Growth Calculator](https://finclac.com/etf): Estimate how your ETF portfolio grows with monthly contributions, expense ratio, and compounding over time
- [EV/EBITDA Calculator](https://finclac.com/evebitda): Calculate enterprise value, the EV/EBITDA multiple, and implied share price versus a peer multiple
- [SIP / Investment Calculator](https://finclac.com/invest): Calculate SIP returns from monthly contributions with the power of compounding
- [Options Profit & Breakeven Calculator](https://finclac.com/options): Calculate breakeven price, max profit, max loss, and profit/loss at expiration for a call or put option — long or short
- [PEG Ratio Calculator](https://finclac.com/peg): Calculate the PEG ratio to check if a stock's P/E is justified by its earnings growth rate
- [How Many Shares Will You Have After a Stock Split?](https://finclac.com/split): See exactly how many new shares you'll own, your new price per share, and your adjusted cost basis after a stock split or reverse split
- [Stock P&L Calculator](https://finclac.com/stock): Calculate stock trading profit and loss including brokerage fees and your exact break-even price
- [SWP Calculator](https://finclac.com/swp): Calculate how long your investment corpus lasts with regular monthly withdrawals, adjusted for inflation
- [XIRR — Irregular Cash Flows](https://finclac.com/xirr): Calculate XIRR for mutual funds, SIPs, and investments with irregular cash flows and dates

## Calculators — Startup & Business (8)

- [Break-even Analysis](https://finclac.com/breakeven): Calculate exactly how many units and how much revenue your business needs to break even
- [Burn Rate Calculator](https://finclac.com/burnrate): Calculate your startup's monthly burn rate and exactly how many months of cash runway you have left
- [CAC & LTV:CAC Ratio Calculator](https://finclac.com/cac): Calculate your customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, and LTV:CAC ratio to see if your growth engine is actually profitable
- [Cash Flow Calculator](https://finclac.com/cashflow): Analyze personal or business cash flow with inflows, outflows, and net cash position over time
- [Stock Dilution Impact Calculator](https://finclac.com/dilutionimpact): See how a secondary offering, option exercise, or convertible note conversion affects EPS and your share value
- [Equity Dilution Calculator](https://finclac.com/equity): Model how startup equity dilutes across multiple funding rounds
- [Pricing Calculator](https://finclac.com/pricing): Calculate gross margin, markup percentage, and contribution margin for your product pricing
- [Revenue Forecast Calculator](https://finclac.com/revenue): Forecast SaaS revenue with bear, base, and bull growth scenarios, ARR, and LTV

## Calculators — Tools (4)

- [Itemized Bill Splitter](https://finclac.com/billsplit): Split a restaurant bill fairly by what each person actually ordered, with tax and tip divided proportionally
- [Currency Converter](https://finclac.com/currency): Convert between major world currencies with up-to-date exchange rates
- [International Money Transfer Cost Calculator](https://finclac.com/remit): Calculate the true cost of sending money abroad, including transfer fees and hidden exchange rate markup vs the mid-market rate
- [Scientific Calculator](https://finclac.com/scientific): Free online scientific calculator with trigonometric, logarithmic, and exponential functions for financial math

## Notes

All calculators produce estimates for general informational and educational purposes only, not financial, tax, legal, or investment advice. Where a calculator or guide cites external data (tax brackets, contribution limits, historical returns), the source is linked directly on that page.
